label: Mutual Non-Disclosure Agreement
description: Mutual confidentiality obligations letting each party disclose confidential information for a defined purpose, on the Common Paper Mutual NDA Standard Terms.

fields.name: purpose
fields.label: Purpose
fields.hint: Why the parties are sharing confidential information

fields.name: effectiveDate
fields.label: Effective date
fields.hint: When the NDA takes effect (a calendar date)

fields.name: mndaTerm
fields.label: MNDA term
fields.hint: How long the NDA lasts: a number of years, or 'until terminated'

fields.name: confidentialityTerm
fields.label: Term of confidentiality
fields.hint: How long confidentiality survives: a number of years, or perpetual

fields.name: jurisdiction
fields.label: Jurisdiction
fields.hint: City or county and state whose courts apply
